object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window you attempted to activate for ${entitlementName} failed.

#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here and attempt to activate the entitlement again.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Notifies the identity who attempted to initiate a Just-In-Time activation window that the attempt did not succeed.
object.name: Just-In-Time Activation Failed
object.subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} failed
